ability.name: Rally the Tribes
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.
ability.declare: If there is a friendly **^^Darkoath Hero^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Unique Darkoath^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
